learning_extracted: The 734-737 'single missing mechanism = MECH-457' conclusion is REFUTED: the predicted fix (dedicated actor-critic) was built and does not clear the foraging floor.

The competence wall is NOT an env/substrate-wiring ceiling: local_view_greedy on the raw 5x5 view clears the floor at 48x -- the env is solvable and the raw observation is sufficient. Every LEARNED agent fails; the wall is a learning/representation interface, not the world.

The surviving hypothesis from the 734-737 structural property ('prediction-trained z_world is action-inadequate') is now leading, but is confounded with a reward-sparsity/exploration failure (train forage plateaus at ~1.2) -- these must be discriminated on separate design axes before naming a build.
